name: TMS OS V14.1.5
notes: Sua loi System Check HTTP 500 trong che do SQLite (duyet dich vu theo danh muc dong); Internet Access bao loi Viet hoi ro rang khi website noi bo chua chay; Dashboard/Runtime Packages chi hien MariaDB khi che do database la mariadb (V14.1.5).
